item.title: Magnitude launches local inference engine for coding agents
item.description: Magnitude offers an open-source desktop inference engine that tunes kernels to local hardware and connects to agents including Codex, Claude Code, and OpenCode; its developers claim up to twice the speed of llama.cpp.

item.title: Pi brings MCP support into its core
item.description: Pi’s developers say MCP is now built into the harness, using a JavaScript sandbox for tool composition and adding support for deferred tool loading and other modern model capabilities.

item.title: Opus 5.5 nerf benchmark has collected seven of 30 days
item.description: The benchmark project says its preregistered daily series has collected seven baseline days and will not produce its first results until around October 24; it does not yet establish model degradation.

item.title: Strata launches governed data layer for analytics agents
item.description: Strata says its semantic layer lets agents query governed live data with row-level security and refuses semantically invalid queries; its marketing claims are not independently verified.
